description: This file implements core tensor operations related to linear algebra, including linear transformation, bilinear layer, tensor dot products, einsum, and other contraction utilities for PyTorch's ATen backend. It contains definitions of functions such as linear, bilinear, tensordot, and einsum, along with helper functions for tensor reshaping and contraction calculations.

methods.name: bool parseLinearFlatten3d()
methods.description: Parses the environment variable 'TORCH_LINEAR_FLATTEN_3D' to determine if 3D tensors should be flattened before linear operation.

methods.name: Tensor _flatten_nd_linear(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const Tensor & bias)
methods.description: Helper function to flatten all but the last dimension of the input tensor, perform linear operation, and then unflatten.

methods.name: Tensor linear(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias_opt)
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on the input tensor with given weight and optional bias, with optimizations for contiguous and 2D tensors.

methods.name: Tensor & linear_out(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias_opt,Tensor & output)
methods.description: Computes linear transformation and writes the result into pre-allocated output tensor.

methods.name: Tensor sumproduct_pair(const Tensor & left_,const Tensor & right_,IntArrayRef sum_dims_,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Performs an optimized sum-product operation on tensor pairs, used in einsum computations.

methods.name: Tensor einsum(std::string_view equation,TensorList operands,at::OptionalIntArrayRef path)
methods.description: Implements Einstein summation notation, parsing the equation string, preparing tensor operands, and performing contractions using batching and summations.

methods.name: Tensor _trilinear(const Tensor & i1_,const Tensor & i2_,const Tensor & i3_,IntArrayRef expand1_,IntArrayRef expand2_,IntArrayRef expand3_,IntArrayRef sumdim_,int64_t unroll_dim)
methods.description: Performs a unrolled dimension trilinear tensor contraction, used for bilinear-like operations.

methods.name: Tensor bilinear(const Tensor & input1,const Tensor & input2,const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias_opt)
methods.description: Implements the bilinear layer, combining two inputs with a weight tensor and optional bias, using the _trilinear helper.

methods.name: Tensor tensordot(const Tensor & input1,const Tensor & input2,IntArrayRef dims1,IntArrayRef dims2)
methods.description: Performs tensor contraction along specified dimensions, similar to matrix multiplication but for higher-dimensional tensors.

methods.name: Tensor & tensordot_out(const Tensor & input1,const Tensor & input2,IntArrayRef dims1,IntArrayRef dims2,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Computes tensor dot contraction with output tensor specified, with device and dtype checks.
